g.text: Lookup error: show an error and retry lookup. Missing product or DeleteProduct=false: refresh the list.
Invalid changes, existing applications or deletion canceled: keep the product; failed validation never reaches UpdateProduct.
Business refusal/intermediate error rolls back this transaction. Unknown save/delete outcome: verify before retry; do not assume rollback or completion.
RunTravelTransaction(productId, work): its FindProduct/HasApplications, validation and update/delete run under the same product lock; repository forwarding is encapsulated.
ModifyTourProduct(productId, productName, theme, level, destination, description, basePrice, travelPeriod, departureDate, image)
